channel.title: Desktop-App on Blowhorn
channel.description: Recent content in Desktop-App on Blowhorn

item.title: Start a post from the page you are reading
item.description: Drag Blowhorn: capture to your bookmarks bar once. Then select a line on any page and click it. Blowhorn opens a new post with your text, the link and the page title already filled in.

item.title: Beyond the API
item.description: Not what the API allows. What you'd do yourself. A 24-second film with burned-in captions: post, reply, repost, quote, comment, invite, follow and react, including inviting your connections to follow your LinkedIn Page, because Blowhorn works the way you do.

item.title: Not a bot. It's you.
item.description: Scale yourself. Not a fleet of bots. A 27-second introduction with burned-in captions: platforms are done with bots, and Blowhorn isn't one. You run it on your own computers, under your own profiles, with your people beside you and you in command.

item.title: Remote team, one army
item.description: Whole team on the line. Each one as themselves. A 24-second film with burned-in captions: no shared-password sheet. Every teammate runs Blowhorn on their own computer, signed in as themselves, over their own connection, and you see the whole fleet and every result in one pane of management.

item.title: Battalion Thunder
item.description: The film from the Blowhorn homepage. A 41-second introduction with burned-in captions: install Blowhorn on as many computers as you like, they fall in as one unit, from a fireteam up, one order goes to one computer, your team joins as a squad, and Major Blowhorn's one call lands on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Reddit, GitHub, Hacker News and Slack.
